patch_description:
Strategy to improve worst_group_margin by:
1. Reducing distinct parameter count from 24 to 8 through aggressive sharing (one param per qubit)
2. Replacing fixed CZ gates with parametrized CRZ gates for better expressiveness
3. Enhancing connectivity beyond linear chain to create richer entanglement patterns
4. Removing redundant RZ pre/post layers and consolidating single-qubit rotations

The shared parameters reduce overfitting and improve robustness on hard samples. Parametrized two-qubit gates provide more trainable degrees of freedom per gate. Enhanced connectivity allows the circuit to learn more complex decision boundaries needed for difficult samples.
